Now filing my nails seems to be the bane of my existence so that why I purchased this drill. It's small and inexpensive which is what we're clearly looking for. I read lots of reviews that spoke of this unit being portable but let me clarify. IT DOES NOT WORK WITHOUT BEING CONNECTED TO A SHORT CORD! Let me tell you what a pain that is! Based

I've been doing my own nails forever, this drill definitely helps along the cuticle line. I also get a more even surface as opposed to using a regular nail file. Definitely takes some practice, be careful if you're starting out!

reviews.t: She never used a drill for nails before and yet she was comfortable and using it like a pro within 5 MINUTES
reviews.x: I bought this for my wife and she loves it. She never used a drill for nails before and yet she was comfortable and using it like a pro within 5 MINUTES. it works very well and she said she likes it a lot. Great purchase. .. only complaint is there were no instructions.

Seller: InnoLife  I would not recommend. I wish it worked, I am unsure how some people even got this to work because it felt shaky and would definitely damage your nail! It does not file, as soon as you set it down it stops entirely. Your better off buying something I little more expensive.

reviews.t: Pretty good! If you're looking for something professional and ...
reviews.x: Pretty good! If you're looking for something professional and something you will use every day all day, then maybe don't get this. As for me, I do my own nails so I use it maybe once every 2 weeks and its great. Works well. The only thing I wish it had was a longer cord, other than that its just what I​ need.

reviews.t: Works well, but detailed instructions would have been helpful...
reviews.x: For me, this little nail drill works very well. It's touted as being good for beginners, but I was really nervous about using it for the first time, because it came with absolutely no instructions. Yikes! I'd cut my nails down to nubbins, and have been wearing falsies, so I figured it was a great way to get some practice.  There are a few notes on the product listing about how to insert and remove the drill bits, so with that being all I had to go on, I just went for it.  As I had no clue as to

I bought this to file down acrylic nails I was doing on myself with dual nail forms (which I don't recommend if you have high c-curve nails, by the way). At first I had to watch a video to figure out to put on the bits, but once I got the hang of it, it was quick and easy. To turn it on, there's a little wheel towards the bottom of the drill where you can control the speed. It worked well enough for filling, though I mostly used the barrel bit for buffing and the sanding for taking down length.

I try (albeit poorly) to do my own nails at home and got really into doing structure gel over nail tips. This drill does the job, but you will need to buy different drill bits because the ones it comes with are almost useless (except for buffing). I bought a couple Kupa Elite nail bits and they fit perfectly in the drill. After owning this roughly 2 years, I have been experiencing trouble with the cord. reviews.t: Even at this cheap price I do not recommend it.
reviews.x: This was so difficult to use. I felt as though my fingers were going to break trying to change the tips on this machine. Pressing that tiny button which should release the tip DOES NOT work and it hurts your fingers. I got extremely frustrated with the item and after only being able to get the two to change out just one time, I returned it. Even at this cheap price I do not recommend it.
I love it! Delivered right on time easy to use 5 stars

I was a little doubtful about this drill because of the price but it really does work. If you press down too much the drill does stop but the whole point is to really not do that, lightly sweep it over your nails and let the sanding do the job. I like the speed dial and the fact that I can control it. For the price, it does what it

Worked well for me without overheating.  I used this on my husbands thick toe nails to thin them out and stop splitting.  Worked great but be careful not to stay in one spot for too long, as it generates heat on the nail quickly! Still a bit too noisy for use on  my skittish little puppy's nails.  He runs! Hopefully in the future he will warm up to it.  I'm using the pet Dremel for now on the low setting.  I originally started to use it for my husbands nails as well, which is what led me to this

I wish i could give this zero stars. It did not work from the moment i took it out of the package and according to the instructions, you need tools to assemble/use the item that are not included. One of my worst purchases.

reviews.t: You get what you paid for
reviews.x: I used this yesterday. First of all the nail bits did NOT fit the drill. Then when I tested to see if the drill worked it smelled like burning plastic. If I could give a negative 3 stars I would.
Should have listened to the reviews. :/ My power cord shorted out the first time I used it. You have to bend the cord a certain way and it is just not useful at all. I'm very disappointed. :(
Do not purchase! I just opened the box and set the drill I was going to use. When I plugged it in and turned it on it was a no go!  Should've  known better not to purchase a cheap drill.

reviews.t: I've used better and worse dremels
reviews.x: I've had this item for 7 months. It just died last night. I use it 1-2 times a month on fingers and toes, maybe for 15 minutes a go. I've used better and worse dremels. If it had lasted a year I would have given it another star. It started to short internally, where the ac adapter goes it. It wants to go for a second, but then quits. No amount of wiggling the cord helped.

After watching the videos on how to use this drill, I was quite confident that this was the drill for me. So I went ahead and ordered it. To my disappointment, the drill did not work. After plugging it in to multiple outlets, there was still no power to the drill. Not sure if the cord was defective, or if it was simply the drill. Either way, this is a horrible product.

Overall satisfied with this purchase. I bought it to file down clear orthodontic aligners. My only compliant is that it seems to heat up while using it and sometimes will slow down spinning. Not sure if this is on all of them or just this one. It does not prevent me from using it as I intended. Great product for the price!

For the price, I'm impressed. Its not going to be the heaviest duty and will take a little longer than a professional drill, but it does the job. Have been using with a dip powder system and like the performance.
Drill bits don't hold they fall out not good I say spend the extra money and get a really good one because this one doesn't work well at all

claims.text: Many reviewers find the drill easy to use, even for beginners, and effective for DIY nail care.
Several reviewers complain that the product comes with no instructions, which is frustrating especially for first-time users.
A common complaint is that the drill stops or stalls when pressure is applied, and some units broke or failed to turn on.
Some reviewers report problems with the bit not tightening or being difficult to change, making the tool hard to use.
Reviewers note the included drill bits are of poor quality and that better bits need to be purchased separately.

qa.q: Will this work on natural nails or only acrylics?
qa.answer: Reviews indicate it works on natural nails, including removing acrylic without damaging the user's own nail [1], filing along the cuticle line [2], and thinning thick toenails [3][5].

claims.text: It was used to remove old acrylic without damaging the user's own nail.
It helps along the cuticle line and gives a more even surface than a regular nail file.
It was used on thick toenails to thin them out.

qa.q: Is it too loud or does it vibrate a lot?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Do the bits fit standard drill handpieces?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some report the bits do not fit or stay secure [1][3][4][5], while one reviewer says separately purchased Kupa Elite nail bits fit perfectly [6].

claims.text: Some reviewers report the bits do not fit or are not secure in the drill [1][3][4][5].
One reviewer says separately purchased Kupa Elite nail bits fit perfectly in the drill [6].

qa.q: Is it safe for beginners to use without damaging nails?
qa.answer: Reviews suggest beginners can use it safely with care: one first-time user was comfortable within minutes [1], and another avoided nail damage by using the lowest setting and not pressing hard [3]. However, others warn it takes practice and to be careful when starting out [4], and that pressing too hard or staying in one spot can cause heat or stopping [5][6].

claims.text: A first-time user was comfortable and using it like a pro within 5 minutes.
One user avoided damaging their own nail by using the lowest setting and not pressing hard.
It takes some practice and beginners should be careful.
Staying in one spot too long generates heat on the nail quickly.
Pressing down too much causes the drill to stop, so it should be swept lightly over the nails.

qa.q: Does it come with everything needed to start, or do I need extra bits?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.
